fields.outputType: Where the frame is written: "file", "database" or "lakehouse". Each type has its own required keys.
fields.mode: "sink" streams the lazy frame to the file; "write" collects it first.
fields.path: The destination path relative to the project root. Nothing is written while authoring or previewing; the file is written when the output is run.
fields.arguments: Options passed to the Polars writer for the format. Leave {} when none are needed.
fields.selected_columns: Optional list of the columns to write, in order; absent writes every column.

configs.name: minimal
configs.intent: Write the priced policies to a Parquet file.

configs.name: realistic
configs.intent: Write only the policy id and premium to a CSV file for the rating team.
